notes: Checked 2026-10-26 on an AsiaTVDrama embed (voe.sx/e/ID). voe.sx answers with a page that sends the browser to a player on a changing domain (window.location.href = '…/e/ID'). The player page keeps its settings in <script type="application/json">["…"]</script>, encoded: rot13, junk pairs (@$ ^^ ~@ %? *~ !! #&) dropped, base64, every character moved back 3, reversed, base64 again; the result is JSON whose source is the HLS playlist. HTML (an encoded page value), no API, nothing executed.
